veranderings.rede: 'Grootmense' (adults) is one word; 'groot mense' means big or tall people.
'langs' means beside in Afrikaans; travelling along a road is 'met die pad ry', so 'langs' here copies English 'along'.

veranderings.voor: Daar loop jy veiliger sonder om tussen die motors te wees.
veranderings.na: Daar loop jy veiliger, weg van die motors.
veranderings.rede: 'sonder om tussen die motors te wees' is wooden; the shorter phrase keeps the meaning and saves words.
'goed' for what something is made of is spoken, informal usage; written study text needs 'materiaal'.

veranderings.voor: 'n motor se band of sy wiel breek
veranderings.na: 'n motor se band of wiel stukkend maak
veranderings.rede: A tyre does not 'breek' in Afrikaans; 'stukkend maak' fits both tyre and wheel at the same word count.

veranderings.voor: Om by daardie plekke te kom, vat langer en kos meer moeite.
veranderings.na: Dit vat langer en kos meer moeite om by daardie plekke te kom.
veranderings.rede: A fronted infinitive clause as subject followed by a comma reads awkwardly; the 'Dit ... om te' construction is the natural Afrikaans form.
